name: token-saver
description: Use Claude more efficiently: live limits and cache timer, cost per reply, in-depth token and cost stats, keep-warm, preflight and auto effort, context breakdown and handoff to a fresh chat.

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache lifetime
cacheTtl.description: auto learns it from this chat's own requests (1h on most subscriptions, 5m on the API), then from your latest main-chat transcripts.

keepWarm.title: Keep the cache warm while idle
keepWarm.description: Sends a tiny cache-read ping shortly before the cache would expire, so your next message does not re-write the whole context.

keepWarmMinutes.title: Keep warm for (minutes after you go idle)
keepWarmMinutes.description: How long past the cache's own lifetime keep-warm keeps pinging before it gives up.

coolingAlert.title: Warn before the cache cools
coolingAlert.description: A toast shortly before a big prompt cache expires while you are idle (10 min before for a 1h cache, 90 s for 5m). Off while keep-warm is on.

preflight.title: Preflight check
preflight.description: prefix: prompts starting with ?? are checked first. always: every prompt you type. auto: no pane; a cheap model picks the effort for each prompt and it is applied to that turn. off: only the Preflight button and /preflight.

helperModel.title: Model for preflight and auto effort
helperModel.description: A cheap model that rates effort, plans and rewrites your prompt.

expensiveTurnUsd.title: Warn when one turn costs more than (USD, API prices)

dailyBudgetUsd.title: Daily budget (USD, API prices)
dailyBudgetUsd.description: A bar in the stats pane and a warning when reached. 0 means no budget.

handoffAtPercent.title: Suggest a handoff when the context is this full (%)

showBand.title: Show the usage bar above the prompt
showBand.description: Context, limits, cache timer and cost in one row (and the status line in a terminal).
